caseNameFull: Hiram T. Chapman, in Error v. Florence Elliott Chapman
attorneys: Mr. William E. Gantt and Mr. Herbert L. Baker for plaintiff in error. Mr. E. F. Colladay, Mr. J. W. Woodrough and Mr. W. F. Gurley for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
*586In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Nebraska.

*587Decided December 17, 1906. Mr. William E. Gantt and Mr. Herbert L. Baker for plaintiff in error. Mr. E. F. Colladay, Mr. J. W. Woodrough and Mr. W. F. Gurley for defendant in error. Per Curiam.
